abstract: Stakeholder engagement processes are structurally oriented toward human participants, leaving non-human actors such as animals and ecological systems unable to participate in the deliberative processes through which environmental decisions are negotiated. While existing approaches including ecological reports, non-human personas, and role-play have raised awareness of more-than-human concerns, they position ecological perspectives as static information rather than something stakeholders can actively engage with during deliberation. Conversational AI represents a promising but underexplored direction for enabling more dynamic, interactive forms of non-human representation in stakeholder engagement. This article investigates the design considerations and ethical boundaries shaping conversational AI systems representing more-than-human perspectives in stakeholder engagement contexts. Using koala conservation in Australia as a grounded case, we conducted a two-phase qualitative study comprising expert interviews with 22 participants across ecology, conservation, urban planning, design and AI, followed by two participatory workshops involving six and five participants, respectively. The first workshop established representational and ethical foundations, while the second examined these through interaction with a voice-based AI agent prototype. Findings reveal that more-than-human conversational agents should operate as accountable ecological proxies, grounded in local evidence and introduced early enough to shape decision-making. We derive six design considerations, including calibrated passivity as a design concept for balancing ecological advocacy with ethical restraint in future multi-stakeholder deliberation. These findings provide a foundation for designing conversational AI systems that can responsibly represent non-human interests within environmental decision-making.

ur.tldr: 聚焦利益相关者参与中被忽视的非人类主体，探讨对话式AI如何在不由人代言时赋予其表达权。分析AI代理的代表性、话语权与责任边界，指出其可扩展参与，但需防范替人类发言及操纵。

title: Giving voice without speaking for: Conversational AI and more-than-human representation in stakeholder engagement
title_zh: 赋予发声权而不代言：对话式AI与超越人类表征在利益相关者参与中的应用
